geometry.operand_dtypes: q,k,v,a,b bf16; A_log, dt_bias, S0 fp32; state fp32

numerics.note: M1 comparator: q1_2b_fixtures.c2_node_refs (float64 C2, one cast of the recorded bf16/fp32 operands) + q1_oracle.per_head_errors; reported next to the time; NOT a pass/fail gate

step.note: verify = graph replay of 48 scans; commit = deployed eager wrapper + committer graph
eager per-layer launcher calls (host launch overhead included)

cut_state_buffer.tensor: kernel._FR13_SUBTREE_CACHE[...]['export'] (fp32 [32,48,128,128], shared by all 48 layers, reused every layer)
cut_state_buffer.note: transient: overwritten by the next layer's level-0 launch; only N_c rows are ever written/read

paper_formula.formula: M_cut = 4 * N_c * B_v * d_k (bytes, fp32) per head/value-tile

replay_rings.note: in-kernel byte copies of k (pre-norm), v, raw a, raw b for all 32 rows x 48 layers (the commit's only input besides the bank)

deployment_page_storage.note: 16 page-shared conv+SSM alias pages (24 rows x 4 MiB), deployed page geometry; not method scratch

memory.note: torch caching-allocator statistics (GB10 unified memory); peaks reset per experiment; graph pools count as allocated

deployment_mode.verify: captured inside the FULL_AND_PIECEWISE model-forward CUDA graph (graph mode is the deployment number)
deployment_mode.commit: eager wrapper (metadata D2D copy + device asserts) + replay of the preseeded fixed16 committer CUDA graph; identical in eager and graph mode

timing_protocol.clock: torch.cuda.Event pairs on the current stream
timing_protocol.state_reset: durable state reset to S0 before each experiment (not between iterations)
timing_protocol.accepted_paths: 28 Hydra27 accepted paths cycled per iteration from a device table (D2D copy inside the commit region)
